## Overview

### Permissions

- **`contents`**: `read`

<!-- usage:start -->

## Usage

```yaml
name: Synchronize Conference Hall speakers
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
permissions: {}
jobs:
  synchronize-conference-hall-speakers:
    uses: cloud-native-aixmarseille/meetup-event-automation/.github/workflows/synchronize-conference-hall-speakers.yml@5a80cd5013781ff071bea0dfda49044bc4071c5f # 2.3.2
    permissions:
      contents: read
    secrets:
      # GitHub App private key.
      # This input is required.
      github-app-private-key: ""

      # Read-only Conference Hall event API key.
      # This input is required.
      conference-hall-api-key: ""
    with:
      # Language for generated reports (en or fr).
      # This input is required.
      locale: ""

      # GitHub App client ID for the private consumer repository.
      # This input is required.
      github-app-client-id: ""

      # Conference Hall CFP slug.
      # This input is required.
      conference-hall-event: ""
```

<!-- usage:end -->
